title: A11yGate pilot success criteria
description: Machine-checkable success criteria for one A11yGate pilot (A11Y-R66). Filled in at kickoff from docs/pilot/success-criteria.template.yml and read by later pilot tooling (A11Y-R69). Targets only: measured results are recorded elsewhere. Automated testing only. Not a WCAG audit, certification or legal advice.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file format. Always 1 for this schema.

pilot.description: Who the pilot is for and when it ends.

customer.description: Customer or team name as agreed at kickoff. Use "[[MISSING]]" until known.

repository.description: Repository the gate runs in, for example "org/app". Optional.

ciProvider.description: CI system the gate runs in.

startDate.description: First pilot day, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (quote it in YAML).

lengthDays.description: Pilot length in days. Must match pilot.lengthDays in config/pricing.json.

decisionDate.description: Date the customer decides to convert, extend or stop, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (quote it in YAML). Normally the last pilot day.

criteria.description: Targets that define a successful pilot. Each one is checkable from CI history, the repository, or the scan outputs.

gateRunsOnEveryPrToMain.description: true = the A11yGate job must run on every PR (or merge request) to the target branch and be a required check. false = not a pilot target.

targetBranch.description: Branch the gate protects. Default: main.

baselineCreated.description: true = a fingerprint baseline (a11ygate baseline create) must be committed to the repository.

maxUnreviewedNewSeriousOrCriticalMergedA.description: Maximum number of new serious or critical findings merged to the target branch after the end of week 2 (day 14) without a recorded review decision (a11ygate review). Usually 0.

pagesOrFlowsCovered.description: Coverage target: the scan must cover at least `min` pages or flows. `list` optionally names them.

min.description: Minimum number of pages or flows covered (N).

list.description: Optional names or URL paths of the pages or flows (for example "/checkout").

evidencePackProduced.description: true = at least one evidence pack (a11ygate evidence pack) must be produced and handed to the customer before the decision date.
